fileId.description: The ID of the file to update.

title.description: The new title of the file to set.

count.description: The number of items in the response.

links.description: The links related to the response.

access.description: The access rights to the file entry.

canShare.description: Specifies if the file entry can be shared or not.

created.description: The date and time when the file entry was created.

createdBy.description: The user who created the file entry.

isAnonim.description: Specifies if the user is anonymous or not.

encrypted.description: Specifies if the file is encrypted or not.

fileEntityType.description:
The file entry type.

1 - Folder
2 - File

fileType.description:
The file type.

0 - Unknown
1 - Archive
2 - Video
3 - Audio
4 - Image
5 - Spreadsheet
6 - Presentation
7 - Document
10 - Pdf

folderId.description: The folder ID where the file is located.

locked.description: Specifies if the file is locked or not.

rootFolderId.description: The root folder ID of the file entry.

security.description: The actions that can be performed with the file entry.

shared.description: Specifies if the file entry is shared or not.

status.description: The status of the API response.

statusCode.description: The HTTP status code of the API response.

total.description: The total number of items available.
